svg.title: Plate VII — The In-App Agent: @buerli.io/ai
svg.desc: A scroll carries the request "Make a flanged bushing: a 60 mm flange with a flat, a 30 mm hub bored through, four bolt holes and a port in its side." A pointing hand leads to an engraving of the result: the flanged bushing of the frontispiece, in iso.
